app.title: SAARTHI Access
app.tagline: Public Journey Accessibility & Evidence Freshness Platform
app.disclaimer: Decision support, not legal certification. Coverage depends on real-world audits and community reports. Unknown is never assumed accessible.
app.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) | Administrative data © Pune Municipal Corporation (OpenCity)

wheelchair.name: Wheelchair / Mobility
wheelchair.desc: Checks entrances, ramps, lifts and accessible toilets against step-free and wheelchair rules (ramp slope up to 8%, door width at least 90 cm unless you change them).

low_vision.name: Low Vision / Blind
low_vision.desc: Checks for tactile guidance paving and audible crossing signals. Signage contrast and obstacle checks are not evaluated yet.

hearing.name: Hearing / Deaf
hearing.desc: Checks the hearing-support features that have been audited. Visual signage and counters are not evaluated yet.

cognitive.name: Cognitive / Plain Language
cognitive.desc: Saved as a support need, but SAARTHI has no measurable rules for it yet, so it cannot change a verdict.

elderly.name: Elderly / Senior Citizens
elderly.desc: Checks step-free access and low-stamina rules.

pregnant.name: Pregnant Women
pregnant.desc: Checks step-free access and low-stamina rules.

low_stamina.name: Low Stamina / Fatigue
low_stamina.desc: Checks low-stamina rules from audited features.

caregiver.name: Caregiver / Companion
caregiver.desc: Checks step-free access for the person you travel with.

verdict.unknown_notice: Unknown is never accessible. One or more critical steps have missing or expired evidence.

place.no_audits: No accessibility audits yet for this place. Status: Unknown.

profile.title: On-Device Access Profile
profile.subtitle: Saved only in this browser. Never uploaded.
profile.privacy: Your needs and limits stay on this device. When you check a place, only the needs codes and any numeric limits you changed are sent, never the profile itself.
profile.statusNotSaved: Not saved yet: using a starting default
profile.combineHint: Choose every need that applies. They are combined.
profile.informationalNote: One or more selected needs have no measurable rules yet. They are saved with your profile but cannot change a verdict.
profile.thresholdHint: Leave these alone to use the published standard values. Only values you change are sent with a check.
profile.customValue: Your own value. The standard is {{value}}.
profile.noEvaluableNeeds: With these choices there is nothing SAARTHI can check, so no journey will be assessed. Choose at least one need with measurable rules.
profile.rulesUnavailable: The rule details could not be loaded. Your profile still works; try again later to see the full list.
profile.unevaluated: No rules exist yet for: {{needs}}. These cannot change a verdict.
profile.ignoredThresholds: Not applied because no matching rule is active: {{list}}.
profile.exported: Profile downloaded as a JSON file.
profile.imported: Profile imported and saved on this device.
profile.importTooLarge: This file is too large to be a SAARTHI profile.
profile.confirmDelete: Delete the profile from this device?

report.title: Report an Accessibility Issue
report.anonymous_notice: Your report is submitted anonymously. Photos will have all faces and vehicle registration plates blurred automatically on upload.
report.consent_checkbox: I consent to uploading this photo for accessibility verification and agree that detected faces and license plates will be permanently blurred.
